source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: The photo shows the course in the middle of being rebuilt (bare, newly shaped fairways and greens with no grass yet, building work by the clubhouse), so only 5 holes could be picked out and their hole numbers are guesses from the card's lengths; the other 13 holes are not traced.
unsure.6: tee placed at the end of a fairway near the clubhouse; no tee box visible
unsure.8: tee placed in the rough west of the clubhouse; no tee box visible
unsure.18: green placed in a hooked fairway south of the clubhouse; its outline was not clear
